evals.name: whole-domain-not-sample
evals.prompt: Design the 'someone else changed this while you were editing' conflict screen for a shared budget app. The requirements name two record types, expenses (amount, description, date, payer, split) and payments (from, to, amount, date), and say a person may use the app from more than one browser. Describe the screen states and the journeys you walked to check them.
evals.expected_output: The design walks the conflict journey for each variant the requirements name: both record types with their own fields, the same person changing the record from another browser, and more than one change landing before the refused save, rather than one expense edited by two people.
expectations: Covers payments with their own fields, not only expenses
Covers the case where the earlier change came from the same person on another browser
Covers more than one intervening change
Does not assume one record type's design carries over unchanged
